item: {"addr": "0x140b5eae0", "comment": "[re]\nAddressLib ID 61506\nhkpWorldOperationUtil::internalActivateIsland(world, island, mergeNeighbours) (our name from Havok 2010; read 2026-11-22): the island moves from the world's inactive list (world+0x50, count +0x58) to the active list (+0x40, +0x48), island+0x32 bit 0 set; EVERY entity in it (island+0x60, count +0x68) gets its deactivation counts zeroed (entity+0x162, +0x164, keeping the world's phase bits +0x3E5..7) and the island activation listeners fire (61777: FOIslandActivationListener 25849 -> hkpRigidBody::OnActivated 25857 per body). Callers: internalMergeTwoIslands (61509: an asleep island touched by an awake body), cleanupDirtyIslands (61522). So a body landing on a sleeping pile wakes all of it at once. docs/re/systems/physics.md, \"A body landing on a sleeping pile\"."}

{"addr": "0x140b5eea0", "comment": "[re]\nAddressLib ID 61508\nhkpWorldOperationUtil::mergeIslands(world, entityA, entityB) (our name from Havok 2010; read 2026-11-22): internalMergeTwoIslands (61509) on the two entities' islands (+0x130) now, or queued as world operation 13 while the world is locked for critical operations (world+0xF8). Called by hkpWorldAgentUtil::addAgent (0x140B7ED40) for two non-fixed bodies in different islands, and by setRigidBodyMotionType (61518)."}

{"addr": "0x140b5eef0", "comment": "[re]\nAddressLib ID 61509\nhkpWorldOperationUtil::internalMergeTwoIslands(world, islandA, islandB) (our name from Havok 2010; read 2026-11-22): the smaller island's entities, agents and constraints move into the larger. If either is in the active list (+0x32 bits 0-1) and the other is not, the inactive one is activated first (internalActivateIsland 61506, with +0x32 active mark set): an awake body whose agent reaches a sleeping pile wakes the whole pile. The merged island keeps a pending split check (+0x31 bits 2-3) of either and the active mark of either."}

{"addr": "0x140b7ed40", "comment": "[re]\nhkpWorldAgentUtil::addAgent(collidableA, collidableB, input) (our name from Havok 2010; read 2026-11-22): a new broadphase pair the collision filter let through. Neither body fixed (motion type +0x160 != 5) and in different islands: mergeIslands (61508) first, then the narrowphase agent is made in that island's agent track (+0x98). So bodies share an island from the moment their AABBs overlap, not from contact; a pair the filter refuses (78553, our played group) never merges, and so never wakes the other."}

{"addr": "0x140b61b50", "comment": "[re]\nAddressLib ID 61522\nhkpWorldOperationUtil::cleanupDirtyIslands(world) (our name from Havok 2010; read 2026-11-16, again 2026-11-22): drains the dirty island list (world+0x60, count +0x68) largest first. Per island: its agent track compacted; activeMark (+0x32 bits 2-3) != isInActiveIslandsArray (bits 0-1): marked active -> internalActivateIsland (61506, merging small neighbours), marked inactive -> deactivateIslandIfStill (61507); a sparse-enabled active island is merged with small active ones (61531 picks, 61509 merges)."}

{"addr": "0x140b5ed40", "comment": "[re]\nAddressLib ID 61507\nhkpWorldOperationUtil::deactivateIslandIfStill (our name; Havok 2010's internalDeactivateIsland; read 2026-11-16, again 2026-11-22): hkRigidMotionUtilCanDeactivateFinal (62264) over every entity's motion (entity+0x150). All pass: the island moves to the inactive list (world+0x50), every body's linear and angular velocity is zeroed (motion vfuncs +0x80, +0x88) and the deactivation listeners fire (61778). One fails: active mark set again (+0x32 |4)."}

{"addr": "0x140b869c0", "comment": "[re]\nAddressLib ID 62264\nhkRigidMotionUtilCanDeactivateFinal(stepInfo, motions, count, motionOffset) (our name from Havok 2010; read 2026-11-16, again 2026-11-22): for each body, (|v|^2 + min(r,1)^2 |w|^2) / 4 - 0.01 <= the w of its deactivation reference with the higher count (entity+0x25C or +0x26C; counts entity+0x162, +0x164 low 7 bits). False at the first body that fails: a moving body keeps its whole island awake."}

{"addr": "0x140b9ffa0", "comment": "[re]\nAddressLib ID 62648\nhkpCharacterProxy: its manifold's rigid bodies pushed (our name; read 2026-11-13 for the Activate, whole 2026-11-22). From the proxy's integrate (62646, from Actor::ApplyMovement 36359's path) each character step. For each manifold contact whose body is not keyframed or fixed (motion type +0x160 not 4 or 5): relative speed along the contact normal -> impulse -0.9 * speed; if the contact's distance (contact +0x1C) is NEGATIVE (the body is inside the capsule): plus distance * (1/timestep, stepInfo+0xC) * 0.4, the penetration recovery, so a body overlapping the capsule is pushed out every step although nobody moves; divided by the body's inverse mass terms, clamped to maxCharacterSpeedForSolver-like limit (proxy+0xBC * dt). Then the object interaction callback (62654 -> bhkCharProxyController 79133, ScaleObjectImpulse 78304), hkpEntity::Activate (60849) and applyPointImpulse (motion vfunc +0xA0). Measured 2026-11-22 (who_wakes): a wheel put back 1.6 units into the guest's standing player was activated 229 times in 4 s and crept out at 0.3 units/s, its pile with it. docs/re/systems/physics.md, \"A body put into a capsule creeps out\"."}
